verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms OpenHands can be used with 'any LLM' and supports 'bring your own model' / BYO LLM keys, implying users can select a specific model rather than rely on auto-selection, but there's no direct documentation of a UI/config toggle for switching between automatic model selection and a manually chosen model. missing for 10: explicit docs on an auto-select mode and the specific setting/flag to override it, hands-on confirmation of switching behavior.
